require 'socket'
require 'json'
require 'logger'
require 'securerandom'

module PaymentProcessor
  class TransactionLogger
    SANITIZE_PATTERN = /[\x00-\x08\x0b\x0c\x0e-\x1f]/
    
    def initialize(log_path)
      @logger = Logger.new(log_path)
      @logger.formatter = proc do |severity, datetime, progname, msg|
        "[#{datetime.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')}] #{severity} -- #{msg}\n"
      end
      @buffer = []
      @mutex = Mutex.new
      @shutdown = false
    end

    def sanitize(input)
      return '' if input.nil?
      input.to_s.gsub(SANITIZE_PATTERN, '').gsub(/[\r\n]/, ' ')
    end

    def log_transaction(transaction)
      @mutex.synchronize do
        return if @shutdown
        entry = format_entry(transaction)
        @buffer << entry
        flush_if_needed
      end
    end

    def format_entry(transaction)
      merchant = sanitize(transaction[:merchant_name])
      amount = transaction[:amount].to_f
      card_suffix = sanitize(transaction[:card_last_four])
      reference = sanitize(transaction[:reference_id])
      status = resolve_status(transaction)
      "TXN merchant=#{merchant} amount=#{amount} card=***#{card_suffix} ref=#{reference} status=#{status}"
    end

    def resolve_status(transaction)
      raw_status = transaction[:status]
      memo = transaction[:memo]
      case raw_status
      when :approved
        "APPROVED"
      when :declined
        "DECLINED"
      when :pending
        "PENDING"
      when :refund
        build_refund_status(memo)
      else
        "UNKNOWN"
      end
    end

    def build_refund_status(memo)
      if memo && memo.length > 0
        "REFUND(#{sanitize(memo)})"
      else
        "REFUND"
      end
    end

    def flush_if_needed
      if @buffer.size >= 10 || @shutdown
        flush
      end
    end

    def flush
      @buffer.each { |entry| @logger.info(entry) }
      @buffer.clear
    end

    def graceful_shutdown(reason)
      @mutex.synchronize do
        @shutdown = true
        @logger.info("Shutdown initiated: #{sanitize(reason)}")
        flush
        @logger.info("Buffer flushed, shutdown complete")
      end
    end
  end

  class PaymentServer
    MAX_REQUEST_BYTES = 8192

    def initialize(port, log_path)
      @port = port
      @logger = TransactionLogger.new(log_path)
      @running = false
    end

    def start
      @running = true
      @server = TCPServer.new('127.0.0.1', @port)
      setup_signal_handlers
      accept_loop
    end

    def setup_signal_handlers
      Signal.trap('TERM') { initiate_shutdown('SIGTERM received') }
      Signal.trap('INT') { initiate_shutdown('SIGINT received') }
    end

    def initiate_shutdown(reason)
      @running = false
      @logger.graceful_shutdown(reason)
      @server&.close
    end

    def accept_loop
      while @running
        begin
          client = @server.accept_nonblock
          Thread.new(client) { |c| handle_client(c) }
        rescue IO::WaitReadable
          IO.select([@server], nil, nil, 1)
        rescue IOError
          break
        end
      end
    end

    def handle_client(client)
      data = client.gets("\n", MAX_REQUEST_BYTES)
      return unless data
      # Reject over-sized requests that did not terminate within the limit.
      if data.bytesize >= MAX_REQUEST_BYTES && !data.end_with?("\n")
        client.puts(JSON.generate({status: 'error', message: 'request too large'}))
        return
      end
      transaction = parse_request(data.strip)
      if transaction
        @logger.log_transaction(transaction)
        client.puts(JSON.generate({status: 'ok', ref: transaction[:reference_id]}))
      else
        client.puts(JSON.generate({status: 'error', message: 'invalid request'}))
      end
    rescue => e
      client.puts(JSON.generate({status: 'error', message: 'internal error'}))
    ensure
      client.close rescue nil
    end

    def parse_request(raw)
      parsed = JSON.parse(raw, symbolize_names: true)
      return nil unless parsed[:amount] && parsed[:card_last_four]
      {
        merchant_name: parsed[:merchant_name],
        amount: parsed[:amount],
        card_last_four: parsed[:card_last_four],
        reference_id: parsed[:reference_id] || SecureRandom.hex(8),
        status: parsed[:status]&.to_sym || :pending,
        memo: parsed[:memo]
      }
    rescue JSON::ParserError
      nil
    end
  end
end

if __FILE__ == $0
  server = PaymentProcessor::PaymentServer.new(8443, '/var/log/payments/transactions.log')
  server.start
end
